questions.question: Devahuti requests Kapila to explain the path of devotional service, which is described as what?

options.text: The ultimate end of all philosophical systems

questions.explanation: "Now I shall request You to explain the path of devotional service, which is the ultimate end of all philosophical systems." (SB 3.29.1-2)

questions.question: Devahuti asks Kapila to describe eternal time, which is a representation of what?
questions.explanation: "Please also describe eternal time, which is a representation of Your form." (SB 3.29.4)

questions.question: Kapila says there are multifarious paths of devotional service in terms of what?

options.text: The different qualities of the executor

questions.explanation: "There are multifarious paths of devotional service in terms of the different qualities of the executor." (SB 3.29.7)

questions.question: Devotional service executed by a person who is envious, proud, violent and angry, and who is a separatist, is in which mode?
questions.explanation: "Devotional service executed by a person who is envious, proud, violent and angry, and who is a separatist, is considered to be in the mode of darkness." (SB 3.29.8)

questions.question: The worship of Deities in the temple by a separatist, with a motive for material enjoyment, fame and opulence, is devotion in which mode?
questions.explanation: "The worship of Deities in the temple by a separatist, with a motive for material enjoyment, fame and opulence, is devotion in the mode of passion." (SB 3.29.9)

questions.question: When a devotee worships the Lord and offers the results of his activities to free himself from fruitive reactions, his devotion is in which mode?
questions.explanation: "When a devotee worships the Supreme Personality of Godhead and offers the results of his activities in order to free himself from the inebrieties of fruitive activities, his devotion is in the mode of goodness." (SB 3.29.10)

questions.question: Unadulterated devotional ecstasy, uninterrupted by any material condition, is compared to what flowing naturally toward the Supreme Lord?

options.text: The water of the Ganges flowing toward the ocean

questions.explanation: "Just as the water of the Ganges flows naturally down towards the ocean, such devotional ecstasy, uninterrupted by any material condition, flows towards the Supreme Lord." (SB 3.29.11-12)

questions.question: A pure devotee does not accept which kinds of liberation, even though offered by the Lord?

options.text: Salokya, sarsti, samipya, sarupya or ekatva

questions.explanation: "A pure devotee does not accept any kind of liberation — salokya, sarsti, samipya, sarupya or ekatva — even though they are offered by the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.29.13)

questions.question: By attaining the highest platform of devotional service, one can overcome what and be situated in the transcendental stage?

options.text: The influence of the three modes of material nature
The need for a spiritual master

questions.explanation: "One can overcome the influence of the three modes of material nature and be situated in the transcendental stage, as is the Lord." (SB 3.29.14)

questions.question: The pure devotee should execute devotional service by giving the greatest respect to whom?

options.text: The spiritual master and the acaryas

questions.explanation: "The pure devotee should execute devotional service by giving the greatest respect to the spiritual master and the acaryas." (SB 3.29.17)

questions.question: Although a devotee is friendly to everyone, whose company should he avoid?

options.text: Persons who are not spiritually advanced

questions.explanation: "Although he is not envious but friendly to everyone, he should avoid the company of persons who are not spiritually advanced." (SB 3.29.18)

questions.question: One who worships the Deity in the temple but neglects the Supersoul present everywhere is described as doing what?
questions.explanation: "If someone neglects or disregards that Supersoul everywhere and engages himself in the worship of the Deity in the temple, that is simply imitation." (SB 3.29.21)

questions.question: One should worship the Deity of the Lord while performing prescribed duties until one realizes what?

options.text: His presence in one's own heart and in the hearts of other living entities

questions.explanation: "One should worship the Deity of the Supreme Personality of Godhead until one realizes My presence in his own heart and in the hearts of other living entities as well." (SB 3.29.25)

questions.question: As what does Kapila say He causes great fear to whoever makes the least discrimination between himself and other living entities?
questions.explanation: "As the blazing fire of death, I cause great fear to whoever makes the least discrimination between himself and other living entities because of a differential outlook." (SB 3.29.26)

questions.question: In Kapila's hierarchy of living beings, who is at the top among human beings divided according to quality and work?

options.text: The intelligent men, designated as brahmanas

questions.explanation: "In that society, the intelligent men, who are designated as brahmanas, are best." (SB 3.29.31)

questions.question: Better than a liberated person, who does Kapila say is best?

options.text: A pure devotee, who executes devotional service without expectation of reward

questions.explanation: "Better than him is a pure devotee, who executes devotional service without expectation of reward." (SB 3.29.32)

questions.question: A perfect devotee offers respect to every living entity because he is convinced that the Lord has entered every body as what?
questions.explanation: "He is under the firm conviction that the Supreme Personality of Godhead has entered the body of every living entity as the Supersoul, or controller." (SB 3.29.34)

questions.question: Anyone who does not know that time is the same Supreme Personality experiences what?
questions.explanation: "Anyone who does not know that time is the same Supreme Personality is afraid of the time factor." (SB 3.29.37)

questions.question: Out of fear of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the wind blows, the sun shines, and what else happens?
questions.explanation: "Out of fear of the Supreme Personality of Godhead the wind blows, out of fear of Him the sun shines, out of fear of Him the rain pours forth showers." (SB 3.29.40)

questions.question: The eternal time factor, the representative of the Lord, brings about the end of the phenomenal world and dissolves the universe by destroying even whom?
questions.explanation: "It dissolves the universe by destroying even the lord of death, Yamaraja." (SB 3.29.45)
